title: inula phylicoides
intro: Inula phylicoides, commonly known as Golden Samosas or Wild Chrysanthemum, is a plant species native to China and other parts of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Inula phylicoides include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects. The health benefits of Inula phylicoides include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anticancer properties.
